l-e-h3-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Na "before you cook", "cook" a ga na peko; na "after you cook", "cook" a ga kozo. Bâ ngoi ti action so a ga na peko ti mot ti bungbi.

l-e-h3-b01-13.title: Nini a lingbi ti yeke oko tongana mo bungbi mot na "and"?
l-e-h3-b01-13.goal: Gi règle na amoko exemple ti forme ti mot so a bungbi na "and" na "but", na pekoni bâ ni na mbeni cas ti nzoni.
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.prompt: Règle wa mo lingbi ti wara na phrase "OK"?
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.o.a: Mot so ayeke na kozoni na peko ti "and" a yeke na nombre ti lettre oko
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.r.a: "Tired" na "happy" a yeke na nombre ti lettre oko pëpe.
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.o.b: Mot so ayeke na kozoni na peko ti "and" a sara forme ti oko
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.o.c: Zia "-ing" na kozoni na peko ti "and"
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: "-ing" ayeke dä mingi pëpe na phrase "OK".
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.o.d: Gï mot ti kete a ga na peko ti "but"
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: "Happy" ti yeke kete ayeke règle pëpe.
l-e-h3-b01-13.s.s1.explain: "Hot-tasty" na "tired-happy" ayeke adjectif, na "quickly-carefully" ayeke adverbe. "Cheap" (adjectif) na "saving time" ("-ing") a yeke na forme ndeni, ndali ni a sara mbi sioni.

l-e-h3-b01-14.title: Mot so a fa résumé a sara na ndo wa?
l-e-h3-b01-14.goal: Gi règle na amoko exemple ti expression so a fa conclusion, na pekoni bâ ni na mbeni cas ti nzoni.
l-e-h3-b01-14.material: "In short, remote work saves commuting time." "Overall, the trip was a success." "To sum up, the bridge needs repair." Bâ expression na kozoni ti phrase oko oko na gi règle.
l-e-h3-b01-14.s.s1.o.a: A ga kozo na phrase négatif
l-e-h3-b01-14.s.s1.o.b: Conclusion a ga na peko ti "In short" na "Overall"
l-e-h3-b01-14.s.s1.o.d: A ga gï na phrase kozo ti texte
l-e-h3-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: Mot ti signal ti résumé a sara na ndo ti ndoni ti texte.
l-e-h3-b01-14.s.s1.explain: "In short", "Overall", na "To sum up" a zia conclusion kete so a bungbi na peko ni. Ni ayeke indice ti gi phrase ti résumé.
l-e-h3-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: Na phrase 3 kue, conclusion a tene na ngoi oko na peko ti expression ti signal, ndali ni ayeke indice so résumé a ga.

l-e-h3-b01-15.title: Sû ti formel a yeke ndeni nini?
l-e-h3-b01-15.goal: Gi règle na amoko exemple ti différence na popo ti sû ti formel na ti tënë ti jour, na pekoni bâ ni na mbeni cas ti nzoni.
l-e-h3-b01-15.material: Formel: "I would like to ask for your help. I do not know the answer." Tënë ti jour: "Wanna help? I dunno." Gi règle na différence ti ye 2 so.
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Ye wa ayeke caractéristique ti sû ti formel?
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.o.a: A sara na forme kue, na contraction wala argot ayeke dä pëpe
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.o.c: A sara na point d'exclamation mingi
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Point d'exclamation ayeke dä pëpe na exemple.
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: A sara na contraction na argot
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke caractéristique ti tënë ti jour.
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s1.explain: A yeke ti formel tongana mo sara na forme kue tongana "I do not know" na mo sara na contraction na argot tongana "wanna" na "dunno" pëpe.
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Sû ti formel a yeke ndeni na tënë ti jour ndali a sû ye kue tongana "I do not know" na a sara na argot pëpe.
l-e-h3-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: Mot tongana "wanna" na "dunno" a ga na sû ti formel pëpe, ndali ni ti zia contraction na argot ayeke caractéristique ti ni.

l-e-h3-b02-11.title: -ful na -less ayeke nde tongana nye?
l-e-h3-b02-11.goal: Wara na fa règle na ndö ti aexemple mingi ti -ful na -less so a zia na nda ti amot, na bâ règle na cas ti sika.
l-e-h3-b02-11.material: help → helpful, helpless / hope → hopeful, hopeless / care → careful, careless. Wara règle ti -ful na -less na nda ti amot.
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Hopeful ayeke fason ti passé pëpe.
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: -ful afa ti ayeke na ~ mingi, na -less afa ti ayeke na ~ pëpe
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Careful na careless ayeke na sens so ayeke nde.
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: -ful afa ti ayeke na ~ pëpe, na -less afa ti ayeke na ~
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Mo bâ ni na lege ti nde.
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Careful afa ti ayeke na care mingi, na careless afa ti ayeke na care pëpe. -ful afa ti ayeke na ye, na -less afa ti ayeke na ni pëpe.
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Tongana careful na careless, -ful afa ti ayeke na ye mingi na -less afa ti ayeke na ni pëpe, ni la asens ayeke nde.
l-e-h3-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Helpful na helpless nga afa ti ayeke na aide na ti ayeke na aide pëpe, ni la règle so ayeke tâ.

l-e-h3-b02-13.material: OK: Save energy / Reduce waste / Reuse bags. NOT OK: Saving energy / Reduce waste / Reuse of bags. Wara règle ti atitre ti liste.
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.prompt: Règle wa mo wara na liste so ayeke OK?
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.o.a: Ye kue ayeke na fason tongana (na ndo so, akomanse na verbe)
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.o.b: Komande ye oko oko na fason ti nde
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.r.b: Liste so ayeke OK ayeke na fason tongana.
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.o.c: Ye kue ayeke na nömörö ti mot tongana
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.r.c: Reuse bags ayeke na mot 2 na Save energy ayeke na mot 2 nga, me règle ayeke ti fason.
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Liste OK akamata na averbes: Save, Reduce, na Reuse. Liste NOT OK ayeke na mélange, na Saving, Reduce, na Reuse of.
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: Liste OK kue akamata na averbes, ni la règle ayeke ti sara aforme même.
l-e-h3-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Liste NOT OK asara mélange na Saving na Reuse of, so aga étrange, ni la règle ayeke forme même.

l-e-h3-b02-14.title: Nyen a lingbi ti zia na yâ ti résumé?
l-e-h3-b02-14.topic: Ye so a zia na yâ ti résumé
l-e-h3-b02-14.goal: Wara na tene règle na aexemples mingi ti ye so a lingbi ti zia na yâ ti résumé, na kaï règle na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-h3-b02-14.material: Original → résumé: "Fruit is healthy; for example, apples have fiber." → "Fruit is healthy." / "Cities are noisy; for instance, traffic never stops." → "Cities are noisy."

l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Ye so angbâ ayeke tënë ti général so ayeke na kozo.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Résumé azia exemple na abata tënë ti général
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: Résumé azia tënë ti général na abata exemple
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.r.c: Ni ayeke ye so akiri: a bata tënë ti général.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.o.d: Résumé akopier original tongana ni ayeke
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: Exemple ayeke dä ape, ni la ni ayeke même na original ape.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Aexemples so aga pekoni ti for example na for instance a zia ni, na a bata tënë ti général so ayeke na kozo. Résumé ayeke na tënë ti général.
l-e-h3-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: Arésumés use azia exemple so aga pekoni ti for example na abata gï tënë ti général, ni la so ayeke règle.

l-e-h3-b02-15.goal: Wara na tene règle na aexemples mingi ti lege so degré ti confiance achange na amots, na kaï règle na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-h3-b02-15.material: "It will rain." / "It will probably rain." / "It might rain." / "I doubt it will rain." Wara règle na lege so aphrases 4 ayeke na confiance.

l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: Phrase ayeke kota mingi, confiance ayeke kota mingi
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.r.b: Kota ti phrase ayeke na ye ti confiance ape.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: Confiance ayeke kete ndö ti na will.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: Ti zia amots tongana probably wala might akpa confiance
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s1.explain: Will ayeke mot ti ti ayeke certain, na ti sara kua na probably wala might asara confiance ayeke kete. Doubt afa mbeni ye so ni aga ape.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: Probably na might asara confiance ayeke kete ndö ti will, ni la amots tongana ala ayeke asignaux so confiance ayeke kete.
l-e-h3-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Will probably na might amû sentiment so a hinga ni ape so nzapa asï wala ape, ni la règle ayeke so confiance aga kete.

l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s2.model.1: Chaque étape ayeke na ngoi ti ni, na total ti ngoi ayeke ala kue a zia tongo, minutes 75, so ayeke ngbele heure 1 minutes 15.

l-e-h3-b06-35.material: Ni ayeke messages tî excuse so a sara na client so colis tî lo aga na retard. A: Sorry, but it wasn't our fault. B: I'm sorry for the delay. We will ship a replacement today.

l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.o.a: B: ndali ni asara excuse na atene solution nga
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.o.b: A: ndali ni areduire responsabilité na prétexte
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.r.b: Prétexte abâ tongana ni aaccepter inconvénient tî client ape.
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.o.c: A: ndali ni ayeke honnête na amû confiance
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.r.c: A azia prétexte kozo tî excuse, ndali ni ayeke ngangu tî mû confiance.
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.o.d: Ala use ayeke même: ndali mot tî excuse ayeke
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.r.d: Atâa na mot tî excuse, ala ayeke nde na so solution ayeke wala pëpe, ndali ni ala ayeke même ape.
l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.explain: B aadmettre retard na atene solution na ngbii kêtê. A azia prétexte kozo, ndali ni client alingbi tî mä colère.

l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s2.model.1: A abâ tongana prétexte tî kpe responsabilité, ndali ni B, so atene solution nga, ayeke alingbi ahon.

l-e-h3-b07-06.title: Oko nyen ayeke neutre, said wala admitted?
l-e-h3-b07-06.topic: Attitude so mbeni verbe ti rapport amû
l-e-h3-b07-06.goal: Kaï alege use, wala atënë use, ti sa décision aphrases ti nouvelles use oko nyen ayeke neutre, sa choix ti oko so alingbi mingi, na fa raison.
l-e-h3-b07-06.material: Mbeni journal aye ti sara kua gï na aphrases neutres. Reporter P: The mayor admitted the bridge is safe. Reporter Q: The mayor said the bridge is safe.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.prompt: Sa choix oko so ayeke nzoni mingi ti rapport neutre, na raison.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.o.a: P: admitted ayeke mot so ayeke tâ mingi
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.a: Admitted amû jugement so zo so aaccepter ni na regret.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.o.b: Q: said atokua amots sans jugement
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.o.c: Use ayeke neutres; averbes afa sens même
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Chaque verbe ti rapport amû attitude ti sio.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.o.d: P: Verbe ayeke kota mingi, ni ayeke neutre mingi
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.d: Verbe ti kota amû attitude ti reporter.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.explain: Said atokua gï fait so a tene mbeni ye, me admitted amû nuance so zo aye ti ti zia ni. Ti bata neutralité, said ayeke choix ti tâ.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s2.model.0: Said atokua gï amots ti maire, me admitted amû jugement so maire aaccepter ni na regret, ni la Q ayeke neutre.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s2.model.1: Admitted ti P amû jugement ti reporter, ni la ni ayeke neutre ape, na ndali so Q, so asara kua na said sans jugement, ayeke tâ.

l-e-h3-b07-07.title: Mbeni note poli na clair ti kpu
l-e-h3-b07-07.topic: Mbeni note so a zia na voisin
l-e-h3-b07-07.goal: Kaï aconditions kue so akiri na mbeni mbeni na ton ti mbeni note so a tokua na voisin ti ndo pekoni, sa choix ti compromis so alingbi mingi, na fa ndali.
l-e-h3-b07-07.material: Mo sara écrire mbeni note na voisin ti ndo pekoni. Aconditions: tene ngoi so ayeke problème, mo bâ voisin ape, na hunda na politesse.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: Ni ablâmer voisin, ngoi ayeke dä ape, na ni ayeke poli ape.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: Ni ayeke poli, me mo lingbi ti hinga ngoi so problème ayeke ape.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: Ngoi ayeke dä, me ni ablâmer voisin.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.explain: Please lower ... after 10 p.m. atene ngoi na amû demande, ni la ni ablâmer zo ape. Ti ndo ti ni abuka mbeni condition kete.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: Ni atene ngoi, amû demande na Please, na amots ti blâme ayeke dä ape, ni la ni akpe aconditions ota kue.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Perhaps ayeke ngoi ape na rude ablâmer, ni la phrase so ayeke na after 10 p.m. na Please use alingbi mingi.
